text: Get It Done!
Chi Lin
Target achieved! My work as the Lady of the Horse Palace is complete!
Wow... It's such a relief to be done!
You did a fantastic job!
And you did it before the deadline...
Thank you for helping me get there, {var:player_nickname}!
When I realized I had piles of work to do, I was afraid I'd never get it all done...
But now I know that it all starts with a single step!
You mean you weren't sure you could finish either?!
Aha-haha...
But hey, like they always say – the tougher the climb, the better the view!
As a deity, I have to keep doing my best to make sure everyone stays healthy as a horse!
I'll do my part as well.
So glad I could help you out!
Thanks! Don't forget that you need to balance work and rest too!
Yeah, I knew you were the right person to ask!
It was hard work, but seeing people's smiles always gave me a second wind.
We spent all this time together…
but as we part ways, it still feels too short...
Huh? You're leaving so soon?
Yep! I'm the type who just can't sit still, y'know?
Take good care of yourself!
I'm looking forward to that day!
Promise me that, when the time comes, we'll burn the breeze together again!
player
Heh, we won't be so busy with work the next time we see each other.
